Unit 1

 Doctors’ Life
 Doctors are thought as noble, respectable, and
caring, but it is really common to read or hear
about the complaints of doctors’ being impatient
and careless.
What are the causes for such complaints?
How can ordinary incidents influence the way
doctors practice medicine?
This unit explores doctors’ life from different
perspectives so that you can understand them better.

 • My choices seem to boil down to entertaining
 fewer thoughts, accepting decreased accuracy
 for each thought, giving up on thorough
 documentation, or having a constant headache
 from neuronal overload. (Para. 10)

Boil down to

 归结为；简化为•
 – It boils down to a question of ethics.
 它可归结成一个伦理学问题。 –

 – 大多数犯罪归结起来可以说都是金钱问题.
• Most of the crimes may boil down to the issue
 of money.

Entertain
• If you entertain an idea or suggestion, you allow
 yourself to consider it as worth thinking about
 seriously.考虑，心存，
•
• I feel how foolish to entertain doubts.
 我竟然怀疑，真是太愚蠢了。•

 我不会考虑从事这样无聊的工作。•
• I wouldn't entertain the idea of doing such a
 boring job.

Trade-off
• A trade-off is a situation where you make a
 折衷，权衡 compromise between two things,

• the trade-off between inflation and
 unemployment.
 在通货膨胀与失业之间求得平衡•

• 合作的经济学基础是自私与慷慨之间的权衡.
• The economic basis of cooperation is the
 tradeoff between selfishness and generosity.

Attend to

 处理•
• He offered to go and attend to the matter.
 他主动提出来处理这件事。•


 我还有一些未完的事要处理。•
• I've got some unfinished business to
 attend to.
